name: To-do
description: A shared to-do list for the whole {environment} and for each {space}, with due dates and reminders.
author: Coffee Pub

settings.label: Show in the Calendar
settings.help: The list also appears in the Calendar's side panel. Dated tasks stay on the Calendar's days either way.

permissions.label: Add, change and tick off tasks

inputHints.remind: True reminds people at 9:00 on the due date, so it needs a due date.
inputHints.due: The day it is due, as YYYY-MM-DD.
inputHints.notes: The notes. Line breaks are allowed.

provides.name: linkTask
provides.label: Link this task to it
provides.description: Link a task to another {object} it is about, so each shows the other.

provides.name: unlinkTask
provides.label: Unlink this task from it
provides.description: Take a task's link to another {object} off, so neither shows the other.

inputHints.target: What it links to, its pointer as the task's links give it.

provides.name: setTaskDue
provides.label: Set this task's due date to its date
provides.description: Set a task's due date, or clear it.

inputHints.date: The day it is due, as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave it out or send "" to clear it, which also turns its reminder off.

provides.name: updateTask
provides.label: Change this task
provides.description: Change a to-do task's title, notes or reminder.

inputHints.title: The new title, up to 200 letters.
inputHints.notes: The new notes, up to 1000 letters; "" clears them. Line breaks are allowed.
inputHints.remind: True reminds at 9:00 on the due date (the task needs one); false cancels the reminder.
inputHints.task: Say at least one of title, notes or remind to change.

provides.name: setTaskDone
provides.label: Tick this task off
provides.description: Mark a to-do task done, or open it again.
